blockers.summary: Two shared-standard promotion proposals await human approval before any write to the shared mjt-pub-api repo: (1) the branching convention (feature work branches off main; no assumption of ownership of the shared working tree), and (2) the devcontainer-first development-environment rule (devcontainer owns venv/dependency setup; no co-equal host-venv path). Both currently live in the primary repo's plans/STANDARDS.md and meet all three promotion tests. Full proposal text is in plans/thread.md. Human replies approve all / approve 1 / approve 2 / reject all / approve with edits. On approval the next PM.ThreadMaintenance run performs the write, which per the branching standard itself should land on a branch off main in mjt-pub-api. After resolution, proceed to Principal.MilestonePlan for B1-M2.
